title: Neighborhoods in Belton ISD Tour
description:
In this episode, we take a drive-through tour of the best neighborhoods in Belton ISD for first-time homebuyers. From family-friendly streets to new construction homes, these communities are some of the most desirable spots in Central Texas.

We’ll explore:
🏡 Westfield in Temple – affordable homes close to schools, shopping, and I-35
🌳 The Groves at Lakewood – a quiet, community-driven neighborhood near Lake Belton
🚶 Three Creeks – new homes surrounded by parks, trails, and incredible outdoor living

Why Watch?

✅ Discover the top Belton ISD neighborhoods for first-time homebuyers
✅ Learn what makes Westfield, The Groves, and Three Creeks stand out
✅ See how each community balances affordability, lifestyle, and location
✅ Get insider insights into the Temple-Belton housing market
✅ Find out why so many families are moving to Central Texas

Whether you’re relocating to the area or buying your very first home, we’re here to guide you through the fast-changing Central Texas market.
